name: ZAR Universal
oneLiner: ZARU is BlockTower's rand token, backed by cash and money-market funds with institutional redemption and retail partner access.
collateral: Rand bank deposits at Standard Bank and unit-trust money-market funds at Sanlam; the retrieved Moore report measures the August 31, 2026 Solana book, not current whole-token allocations.
pegMechanism: One ZAR per token through BlockTower's verified institutional mint/redemption service; retail access through network partners. Fiat settlement may take up to five business days, and partner fees and minimums vary.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos refinement Refine02 primary-source and RPC review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The whitepaper defines a fixed-rand, issuer-native liability backed by bank deposits and money-market instruments, not a variable-NAV fund share. Canonical Solana mint creation and initialization at slot 373091718 on 2025-10-13 bind the implementation date; later EVM native deployments are not substituted for that canonical mint's age.
